prompt: Automatically write a one-line description of each photo on a website for screen readers.
why: Captioning images is image analysis (Azure Vision).
trap: Object detection locates things; a caption describes the scene.

prompt: A photo library wants tags like 'beach', 'dog' and 'sunset' added to every picture.
why: Tagging image content is image analysis.
trap: No positions are needed, so it isn't object detection.

prompt: A marketplace wants each listing photo described and its main subject identified, with no need for locations of items.
tells: no need for locations of items
why: Describing images without locating objects is image analysis.
trap: Locations would make it object detection.

prompt: Generate thumbnails that keep the most important part of each photo in frame.
tells: keep the most important part of each photo
why: Smart cropping is an image-analysis feature.
trap: No new image is being created.

prompt: A marketing team's 200,000 images need searchable labels like 'outdoor', 'team' and 'laptop'.
trap: No locations needed, so not object detection.

prompt: For each photo, describe the overall scene in one sentence.
tells: describe the overall scene in one sentence
why: A caption of the whole scene is image analysis.
trap: A multimodal model could, but no question is being asked; it's a standard caption.
